normative_boundary: This registry enumerates plan-derived IDs and provisional assignments only. It does not reproduce or replace absent governing requirement text.

governing_source_state.continuation_boundary: Local MVP implementation and tests may continue as development evidence, but source-dependent requirements and gates cannot close.

owners.requirements-and-release-owner: Accepts controlled governing sources and coordinates traceability reconciliation.
owners.g1-p0-team: G1 platform, systems/inference, workflow/storage, security, and UI integration owners.
owners.g2-cross-functional-team: G2 platform, systems/inference, agent/workflow, storage, security, QA, and release owners.
owners.g3-cross-functional-team: G3 storage, desktop/application, inference, compatibility, security, QA, and product/UX owners.
owners.g4-hardening-team: G4 component owners under QA, security, release, and architecture leadership.
owners.g5-release-team: G5 release, QA, security, platform, product/UX, and support owners.
owners.g6-large-model-team: G6 A2 team with multi-GPU inference and qualification specialists.
owners.g7-distributed-systems-team: G7 distributed-systems, SRE/storage, PKI, and test owners.
owners.rx-research-team: Separately authorized RX kernel/platform, driver, security, compatibility, and inference researchers.
owners.gwin0-cross-functional-team: GWIN0 architecture/platform, Windows/release, storage/security, and inference owners.
owners.gwin1-cross-functional-team: GWIN1 Windows storage, lifecycle, QA, and operations owners.
owners.gwin2-qualification-team: GWIN2 platform, Windows, security, QA, release, and support owners.

environments.E0: Initial environment named by G0; exact governed definition unavailable.
environments.E1: First named x86-64 A1 reference machine established by G0.
environments.E2: Second named x86-64 A1 reference machine established by G0.
environments.E3: A2 environment named by the G6 dependency set; exact governed definition unavailable.
environments.E4: A2 environment named by the G6 dependency set; exact governed definition unavailable.
environments.E5: A2 environment named by the G6 dependency set; exact governed definition unavailable.
environments.E6: Physical ARM64 board required by G6.
environments.E7: Distributed lab environment named by G7; exact governed definition unavailable.
environments.E8: Initial environment named by G0; exact governed definition unavailable.
environments.E9: Distributed lab environment named by G7; exact governed definition unavailable.
environments.E10: Distributed lab environment named by G7; exact governed definition unavailable.
environments.LARGE_MODEL_HOST: Suitable real-hardware host for the G1 placement/load experiment.
environments.RX_REFERENCE_BOARD: One documented physical reference board for RX research.
environments.WIN11_WSL2: Supported Windows 11 x64 host with WSL2.
environments.WIN11_HYPERV: Windows 11 Pro/Enterprise host with Hyper-V and a qualified guest.
environments.WIN11_DUAL_BOOT: Disposable Windows 11 dual-boot fixture with firmware-key recovery capability.
